{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ereesi''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ereesus]] in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]. Members of the species were heavily involved in [[Slavery/Legends|slave trading]] and Ereesus was the site of a profitable slave trade. In [[4200 BBY]], the Ereesi species engaged in slave raids throughout the sector. Their harassment of the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdans]] prompted the latter to join the Galactic Republic that year. In [[3970 BBY]], [[Argazdan Redoubt]] forces devastated Ereesus, exterminating all life including the Ereesi slavers in retaliation for the latter's depredations.
